en.html:
《Between life and death, laugh at yourself; in rapture, forget yourself.》
《Then let dawn's lament toll the curtain up on divine comedy.》
en.text:
《Between life and death, laugh at yourself; in rapture, forget yourself.》
《Then let dawn's lament toll the curtain up on divine comedy.》

ja.html:
[text0010a]
《生と死の狭間に己を笑い恍惚として自ら忘るる》
《されば夜明けの嘆きを鐘に神曲の幕よいざ上がれ》
ja.text:
[text0010a]
《生と死の狭間に己を笑い恍惚として自ら忘るる》
《されば夜明けの嘆きを鐘に神曲の幕よいざ上がれ》

en.html:
《The miracle-working saint saves living beings, curses God and vomits.》
《The golden-helmed conqueror subdues ten thousand leagues, then sinks with his beloved horse to the riverbed.》
《The lake's fair princess forsakes her realm for love, and is executed, drowning in excrement.》
《The orphaned babe drinks earthworm blood as mother's milk; in three nights, rot begins within its belly.》
en.text:
《The miracle-working saint saves living beings, curses God and vomits.》
《The golden-helmed conqueror subdues ten thousand leagues, then sinks with his beloved horse to the riverbed.》
《The lake's fair princess forsakes her realm for love, and is executed, drowning in excrement.》
《The orphaned babe drinks earthworm blood as mother's milk; in three nights, rot begins within its belly.》

ja.html:
[text0010b]
《奇跡を行う聖人は衆生を救い神を呪って嘔吐する》
《黄金の兜の覇王は万里を征し愛馬と共に川底へ沈む》
《湖の美姫は国を捨て愛を選び糞尿に溺れて刑死する》
《孤赤児は蚯蚓の血を母の乳とし三夜して腹より腐る》

《孤赤児は蚯蚓の血を母の乳とし三夜して腹より腐る》

en.html:
《Life, hear this hymn: laughter-weary lament piled upon lament.》
《Life, hear this prayer, pillowed on joy that trembles with anger.》
《A hundred years of life shall be adorned with interlocking rings of fire and sword.》
《Seven days of life shall shine in innocence, guarded by darkness and silence.》
《Dance, beast. Race across the fields. Sing, revel, rage and run.》
《Now every chain and cage before you is a crumbling clod of earth.》

ja.html:
[text0010c]
《生命よこの賛歌を聞け笑い疲れた怨嗟を重ねて》
《生命よこの祈りを聞け怒りおののく喜びを枕に》
《百年の生は炎と剣の連環が幾重にも飾り立てよう》
《七日の生は闇と静寂に守られ無垢に光り輝くだろう》
《獣よ踊れ野を馳せよ唄い騒いで猛り駆けめぐれ》
《いまや如何なる鎖も檻も汝の前には朽ちた土塊》
